author: claude
summary: Task 004 of the voices-variants-round2 plan: new shared MultiSelect primitive (chip trigger + checkbox-style panel), the first compact multi-value combobox in the codebase (ManySelect is a chip-toggle row, not a dropdown). Feeds task 005 (catalog filter bar).

files.change: New file. MultiSelectOption/MultiSelectProps API. Trigger button (44px min-height) shows removable chips + placeholder; AnimatePresence panel styled like SearchableSelect's; role=listbox + aria-multiselectable, rows are role=option + aria-selected; roving highlight via Arrow Up/Down, Space/Enter toggles without closing, Escape closes + refocuses trigger, click-outside closes. KNOWN ISSUE (flagged for the plan's mandatory adversarial review, not yet fixed): each chip's remove control is a <span role="button"> nested inside the trigger <button> -- invalid nested-interactive markup and not independently keyboard-focusable (no tabIndex).

New file. 12 tests: chip rendering, placeholder, click-toggle, panel-stays-open-after-toggle, keyboard toggle, chip removal, Escape/outside-click close, aria-multiselectable/role=option/aria-selected correctness, disabled state.

flow_impact: Second task landed in the voices-variants-round2 plan. To be registered in design-docs/specs/design-system.md §6 by task 010 (spec sync), once the known chip-keyboard issue above is resolved by the adversarial review pass.
